title: Claim (borg-agent/claim@1)
description: One plain statement about the game, with its evidence (R4). The knowledge base is the product: claims live in JSON Lines under knowledge/, point at immutable run records and never edit them (R4.1). A model never sets a status past 'hypothesis' (R4.3); a probe result or a review by a different model family moves it on, and the owner decides what becomes part of the remake's specification.

statement.description: One plain sentence a person can check. Not a list, not a tactic plus its reason.

scope.description: Where the claim is meant to hold. An absent field means the claim does not depend on it; null means 'any'.

gear.description: What the character must have or lack for the claim to hold.

engine.description: The engine it was learned on (R4.4). A claim learned on Neo is not assumed to hold on C until it is checked there.

status.description: The lifecycle of game-archaeologist's ADR-008, adapted: 'documented' means the manual says so.

superseded_by.description: The id of the claim that replaces this one.

kind.description: 'static:*' are phase 2 and later only; phase 1 must not read those sources (SOURCES.md).

trials.description: M, for a quantified basis: 'N of M'.

reference.description: For 'manual', the manual file and section; for 'static:*', the file and the pinned commit.

evidence.description: Every piece replayable (R5): a run id with the turn it refers to, or a passage of the manual.

note.description: What that run shows, in a line.

reference.description: The manual file and section, or the other claim's id.

confidence.description: In words (R4): what the claim rests on, and which other explanations were ruled out.

alternatives_ruled_out.description: Each explanation that was considered and why it was ruled out. An empty list is allowed and says plainly that none was.

test.description: Required for a tactic or a readiness claim (R4): the experiment or probe a program would run to confirm or refute it.

phase.description: Which phase produced it: 1 player-learner, 2 Borg archaeologist, 3 reconciler.

sources.description: What the producer was allowed to read, by the names in docs/SOURCES.md.

produced_by.description: Who wrote the claim. A model may not promote its own claim (R4.3), so this says which model and family did.

reviews.description: Each review that moved the status. A review by a model of the same family as the producer does not count (R4.3).

by.description: The reviewer: a model id, a family, 'owner' or a probe's run id.

then.description: A tactic or readiness claim says how a program would test it (R4).
'documented' means the manual says so, so its basis is the manual.
A model never promotes its own claim past 'hypothesis' (R4.3): a corroborated claim names the probe or the reviewer of another family that moved it.
Phase 1 must not read the game source, the Borg source or spoilers (SOURCES.md).
